title: HARP Identity Request
description: Request body posted to the identity_endpoint to register an agent. The type field selects one of the three flows: anonymous, identity_assertion, or service_auth.

oneOf.title: Anonymous request
oneOf.description: Deferred ownership. Returns a pre-claim token limited to the free tier; a human claims the account later.

oneOf.title: Identity assertion request
oneOf.description: ID-JAG flow. The agent presents an audience-specific assertion from its provider; the service verifies it and mints a scoped token. Synchronous, no human.

oneOf.title: Service auth request
oneOf.description: Verified-email flow. The agent supplies a login hint, the user verifies at a verification_uri, and the agent polls the token endpoint until granted.

login_hint.description: Email address used to reach the human who must verify.
